gripOrHq.title: Rockerboy Promotion
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

gripOrHq.title: Bioweapons Engineering
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Chicago Branch
gripOrHq.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Vacant Soulkiller
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Vacant Soulkiller before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Vacant Soulkiller, it does 1 brain damage for each advancement counter on it.

rig.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

ice.title: Rex
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].
